Quick thoughts: I’m inclined to structure this as a conditional, one-time invoice credit (applied after full payment) only if they:

Requesting VP/CFO signoff for up to $60k one-time credit conditioned on the bullets above. If you want, I can push for a 15% cap and market it as a one-time onboarding accommodation.

Ben
